hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if echo "$f" | grep -q 'backend/'; then result=$(npm run lint --prefix backend 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "Lint errors remaining after --fix:"; echo "$result"; exit 1; fi; fi

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if echo "$f" | grep -q 'frontend/'; then result=$(npm run format --prefix frontend 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "Format errors:"; echo "$result"; exit 1; fi; fi
